mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 3 consecutive years of data.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS increase > 0.5% in past month, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in at least 3 consecutive years of data.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average during high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals an impending economic slowdown that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 12-month MA and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 3 consecutive years of data.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) signals strong residential construction activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it reflects a healthy economy and rising consumer confidence.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1.0% over a 3-month period signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 3 consecutive years of data.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals an aggressive monetary policy response to an inflationary shock, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in at least 3 consecutive years of data.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) during strong labor force participation (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% annually) signals a robust labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor force participation (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% annually)
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% annually, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in at least 3 consecutive years of data.
